diagnostic_evidence.external_durability: Owner must copy the exact single-line JSON (and report SHA-256 when visible/retrieved) to Core before deleting the Codespace. Core then records that nonsecret evidence durably on PR #74. Codespace deletion is mandatory after evidence transfer. The diagnostic program itself performs no GitHub write.
diagnostic_evidence.if_terminal_pane_closes_after_successful: The future reviewed operator sequence may open one ordinary Codespaces terminal solely to retrieve the fixed nonsecret result file using the exact retrieval command; no repository code, auth command, or diagnostic rerun is authorized.

diagnostic_session_contract.step3_replacement: For a future separately Owner-approved diagnostic-only session, replace production Step-3 only with this addendum's verified diagnostic payload. Do not deliver Step-4 Action A or Action B in that session.
diagnostic_session_contract.steps_0_through_2_6: Use exact already-reviewed v8 sequence under DIRECT_CLIPBOARD_COPY_PASTE_ONLY; no prior-session state may be reused.

placeholders.__DIAGNOSTIC_ADDENDUM_BLOB__: After this addendum commit is created, substitute the exact blob SHA of this addendum.
placeholders.__DIAGNOSTIC_CANDIDATE_HEAD__: After this addendum commit is created, substitute the exact new PR #74 diagnostic candidate head.

exact_diagnostic_program_template.substitution_contract: Replace each placeholder exactly once with the corresponding lowercase 40-hex Fresh-frozen value. No other decoded byte may change. Core must publish the derived exact decoded SHA-256, byte length, base64 length, base64 SHA-256, received marker and tmpfs path in a nonsecret delivery-manifest comment before Lab review.
exact_diagnostic_program_template.template:
set +e
set +x
umask 077
PHASE_C_DIAG_CANDIDATE_HEAD='__DIAGNOSTIC_CANDIDATE_HEAD__'
PHASE_C_DIAG_ADDENDUM_BLOB='__DIAGNOSTIC_ADDENDUM_BLOB__'
PHASE_C_DIAG_V8_HEAD='9928153160692c8ecdcd7a076a472384bc8b20e9'
PHASE_C_DIAG_V8_BLOB='f359b13f37b7251634e5dcb7fdf71130a3b1216d'
PHASE_C_DIAG_CANONICAL_MAIN='74ea95e59ac0654e1a0c1f811a178b3eef7b073c'
PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT='/dev/shm/multiverse-r1-stage1-phase-c-step3-diagnostic'
PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/result.json"
PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_TRACE="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/phase_c_verify_first_failure.tsv"
PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDOUT="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/preflight.stdout"
PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDERR="$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT/preflight.stderr"
test ! -e "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_ALREADY_EXISTS_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 87; }
command mkdir -m 700 "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_CREATE_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 87; }
test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT")" = '700' && test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT")" = "$(command id -u)" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 87; }
PHASE_C_DIAG_FS="$(command stat -f -c '%T' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ROOT")"
{ test "$PHASE_C_DIAG_FS" = 'tmpfs' || test "$PHASE_C_DIAG_FS" = 'ramfs'; } || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOT_NOT_MEMORY_BACKED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 87; }
: > "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_TRACE"
: > "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDOUT"
: > "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDERR"
(
  set +e
  set -E
  trap 'rc=$?; if [ ! -s "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_TRACE" ]; then command printf "%s\t%q\n" "$rc" "$BASH_COMMAND" > "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_TRACE"; fi' ERR
  phase_c_verify
)
PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC=$?
PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_EXECUTED=0
PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_RC=255
if [ "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC" -eq 0 ]; then
  PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_EXECUTED=1
  ( cd "$EXEC_ROOT" && /usr/local/python/current/bin/python -B tools/multiverse_r1_stage1_phase_c_execution_preflight_v1.py ) >"$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDOUT" 2>"$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDERR"
  PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_RC=$?
fi
/usr/local/python/current/bin/python -B - "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_TRACE" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDOUT" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_STDERR" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_EXECUTED" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_RC" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_CANDIDATE_HEAD" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_ADDENDUM_BLOB" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_V8_HEAD" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_V8_BLOB" "$PHASE_C_DIAG_CANONICAL_MAIN" "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" "${GH_CONFIG_DIR:-}" "$EXEC_ROOT" <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,os,sys
(result_path,verify_trace_path,stdout_path,stderr_path,verify_rc_s,preflight_executed_s,preflight_rc_s,candidate_head,addendum_blob,v8_head,v8_blob,canonical_main,codespace_name,gh_config_dir,exec_root)=sys.argv[1:]
verify_rc=int(verify_rc_s)
preflight_executed=preflight_executed_s=="1"
preflight_rc=int(preflight_rc_s) if preflight_executed else None
verify_trace=open(verify_trace_path,"r",encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read().strip()
preflight_stdout=open(stdout_path,"r",encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read()
preflight_stderr=open(stderr_path,"r",encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read()
if verify_rc==0:
    verify_reason="PASS"
elif verify_rc==41:
    verify_reason="PHASE_C_VERIFY_HEAD_MUST_BE_DETACHED"
elif verify_rc==42:
    verify_reason="PHASE_C_VERIFY_ASSUME_UNCHANGED_PROHIBITED"
elif verify_rc==43:
    verify_reason="PHASE_C_VERIFY_SKIP_WORKTREE_PROHIBITED"
elif verify_trace:
    verify_reason="PHASE_C_VERIFY_FAILED_COMMAND:" + verify_trace.split("\t",1)[-1]
else:
    verify_reason="PHASE_C_VERIFY_NONZERO_WITHOUT_TRAP_DETAIL"
parsed=None
json_status=None
denied_reason=None
if preflight_executed:
    try:
        parsed=json.loads(preflight_stdout)
    except Exception:
        parsed=None
    if isinstance(parsed,dict):
        json_status=parsed.get("status")
        if json_status=="DENIED_FAIL_CLOSED":
            denied_reason=parsed.get("reason")
pass_marker_present=(json_status=="PHASE_C_NONMUTATING_PREFLIGHT_PASS") or ("PHASE_C_NONMUTATING_PREFLIGHT_PASS" in preflight_stdout)
session_binding_material="\n".join([canonical_main,v8_head,v8_blob,candidate_head,addendum_blob,codespace_name,gh_config_dir,exec_root]).encode()
report={
  "schema_version":"MULTIVERSE_R1_STAGE1_PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT_v1",
  "status":"PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_NO_STEP4",
  "binding":{
    "canonical_main_expected":canonical_main,
    "production_v8_head":v8_head,
    "production_v8_blob":v8_blob,
    "diagnostic_candidate_head":candidate_head,
    "diagnostic_addendum_blob":addendum_blob,
    "codespace_name":codespace_name,
    "gh_config_dir":gh_config_dir,
    "execution_root":exec_root,
    "diagnostic_session_id":hashlib.sha256(session_binding_material).hexdigest()[:32]
  },
  "phase_c_verify":{
    "rc":verify_rc,
    "failure_reason":verify_reason,
    "first_failure_trace":verify_trace
  },
  "preflight":{
    "executed":preflight_executed,
    "rc":preflight_rc,
    "stdout":preflight_stdout,
    "stderr":preflight_stderr,
    "json_status":json_status,
    "denied_fail_closed_reason":denied_reason,
    "pass_marker_present":pass_marker_present
  },
  "step4_delivered":False,
  "production_apply_invocations":0,
  "production_mutation_performed":False,
  "runtime_activation_performed":False
}
encoded=(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))+"\n").encode()
fd=os.open(result_path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as f:
    f.write(encoded)
os.chmod(result_path,0o400)
print("PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_REPORT_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())
print("PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT="+encoded.decode().rstrip("\n"))
PY
PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC=$?
if [ "$PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC" -ne 0 ]; then command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE_NO_RETRY' >&2; exit 87; fi
test -f "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT" && test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT")" = '400' && test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$PHASE_C_DIAG_RESULT")" = "$(command id -u)" || { command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 87; }
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_STEP3_DIAGNOSTIC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_NO_STEP4'
command printf '%s\n' 'PHASE_C_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_STOP_COPY_RESULT_THEN_DELETE_CODESPACE'
unset PHASE_C_DIAG_VERIFY_RC PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_EXECUTED PHASE_C_DIAG_PREFLIGHT_RC PHASE_C_DIAG_REPORT_RC

phase_c_verify_observability.failure_reason_capture: ERR trap records the first failing BASH_COMMAND using Bash %q when available. Existing explicit RCs 41/42/43 are mapped to detached-HEAD / assume-unchanged / skip-worktree reasons. Any nonzero without trap detail is explicitly reported as unknown rather than guessed.

problem.auditor_conclusion: The current Step-3 wrapper collapses phase_c_verify/preflight failures into outer exit 92. The deleted session therefore cannot prove the inner cause. Canonical execution_preflight_v1.py already emits nonsecret DENIED_FAIL_CLOSED JSON with exact reason, so current evidence supports an operator/observability-sequence addendum rather than support-code modification.

review_order.owner_approval_scope: exactly one diagnostic-only Codespace session; not production retry
review_order.production_owner_approval_after_diagnost: separate future gate if and only if cause is classified/remediated and independently reviewed as required

stop_cleanup_contract.on_phase_c_verify_nonzero: Capture RC/reason; do not run canonical preflight; report and stop.
stop_cleanup_contract.on_preflight_nonzero: Capture full stdout/stderr/RC/reason; report and stop.
stop_cleanup_contract.on_preflight_pass: Capture PASS evidence; still stop. Diagnostic-only session never transitions to Step 4.
stop_cleanup_contract.on_success: Capture report, leave shell non-authoritative for production, deliver no Step 4, copy result to Core, then delete Codespace.
stop_cleanup_contract.on_transport_or_diagnostic_capture_failu: STOP. Do not repair/retype/rerun. Do not deliver Step 4. Delete Codespace and return for review.

transport_contract.action_a: Inert RFC4648 base64 assignment plus receipt marker only, delivered by direct clipboard copy/paste.
transport_contract.action_b: Use exact v8 absolute-Python loader template with diagnostic tmpfs payload path and exact derived decoded SHA-256.
